children: ICICI Securities's research report on Apollo Hospitals Enterprise

Apollo Hospitals (Apollo) delivered a strong Q2FY27 performance, with all three business verticals delivering healthy double-digit revenue growth. Hospital business grew 23% YoY, led by 19% growth in established hospitals. Occupancy improved 400bps YoY to 73%, despite addition of 472 beds in H1FY27. An INR 348mn EBITDA loss at its new hospitals dragged overall hospital margins by 60bps YoY to 24%, while EBITDA margins of established hospitals stood at 25.8%. Online pharmacy, 24/7, turned cash EBITDA-positive; the focus ahead is on boosting order inflow, efficiencies and cost discipline. Management now expects Healthco margins (incl. Keimed) to touch ~6% by Q4FY27 (earlier guidance of 6.57%). We cut FY28E EBITDA by 1% to factor in lower margins in Healthco. Maintain HOLD; TP unchanged at INR 8,500.

We maintain our HOLD rating, with an unchanged TP of INR 8,500. We value the hospital business at 25x FY28E EV/EBITDA, offline pharmacy at 21x FY28E EV/EBITDA, online pharmacy at 2x FY28E EV/sales, Keimed at 15x FY28E EV/EBITDA and AHLL at 12x FY28E EV/EBITDA (maintained for all segments).
